verdict.rationale: Sardine documents APIs, async webhooks and a case-management workspace. None of the evidence describes stable external identifiers, such as client-supplied customer or case IDs, that a developer could use to reconcile records. Customer-record reconciliation is a fair axis for an API-driven risk platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
